subject: Private marketplace amendment & renewal request — Acme Health
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.cfo@acmehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>, CFO <cfo@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal paperwork + capacity increase request (Acme Health)

Hi Michael —

Hope you’re well. Our current private offer with Redwood (through AWS Marketplace) is up for renewal end of August (contract expires 2027-08-31). We’d like to discuss two items before we sign: a 12‑month renewal (start 2027-09-01) and an increase to our committed capacity. Current committed units are 50k tokens/month; we’re requesting to move to 150k tokens/month to cover Q4 growth expectations.

Two asks for you:
- Can Redwood provide an AMS Private Offer amendment with updated pricing/commit for 12 months?
- Can you confirm whether billing will remain via AWS Marketplace (monthly usage invoiced through AWS) or if we need a separate invoice flow? We prefer to keep marketplace billing if possible.

Attaching our PO form for internal procurement. Please loop in marketplace ops and legal as needed. Also need SOC2 attestation (for our internal auditors) attached to the renewal packet.

Attachment: Acme_PO_Form.pdf

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
VP, Finance — Acme Health

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.cfo@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + capacity increase request (Acme Health)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and the PO. Happy to get this moving.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I’ll coordinate a private-offer amendment draft and pricing proposal (Marissa will own the Marketplace flow).
- Rafael will review legal terms and confirm any redlines required for the amendment.
- We’ll include SOC2 evidence with the renewal packet (I’ll attach the attestation PDF).

Couple questions so we can size the amendment properly:
1) Is the 150k tokens/month intended as a committed monthly minimum or as a one-time uplift for Q4 (seasonal)?
2) Billing contact (name + email) for AP so we can align the PO and marketplace invoicing.

I’m attaching our standard PO template to speed signatures on your side if needed. Will aim to return a fully populated private-offer amendment by EOD 2027-07-02.

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template_v3.pdf

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal paperwork + capacity increase request (Acme Health)

Thanks Michael — looping in marketplace ops/finance details.

Samantha / Acme team — copying you so you have direct contacts: I run Marketplace Ops for Redwood. We can support an AWS Private Offer amendment that:
- Extends the term for 12 months starting 2027-09-01;
- Updates committed capacity to 150k tokens/month as a new commitment tier;
- Keeps billing through AWS Marketplace (standard Marketplace monthly billing applied against the private offer), unless your AP team requests a direct invoice.

Preliminary pricing guidance (subject to final deal math):
- Current 50k tier effective rate: $0.018 /k tokens
- Proposed 150k tier (annual commit): $0.0125 /k tokens (volume tiering applied)
- One-time onboarding credit for moving to annual commit: $25k credit applied to first invoice if signed by 2027-07-15.

Action items / timeline:
- Acme: confirm committed monthly interpretation (monthly minimum vs seasonal uplift) and provide AP contact.
- Redwood (marketplace): prepare Private Offer amendment and a PO calculator exported as an XLS so your procurement can validate monthly billing runs (attached).
- Legal: Rafael to draft minimal redline; target internal review by 2027-07-02.

Attachment: PO-Calculator.xlsx

If all looks good I can submit the private offer to AWS Marketplace once we have the signed amendment and PO.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head, Marketplace Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.cfo@acmehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>, CFO <cfo@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + capacity increase request (Acme Health)

Thanks Michael + Marissa —

Answered below:
- The 150k tokens/month is intended as a committed monthly minimum for 12 months (we want predictability for budgeting).
- AP contact: Maria Gonzales, AP Manager, ap.team@acmehealth.com.
- We confirmed we prefer billing to remain in AWS Marketplace. Monthly usage through AWS is preferable.

Attached is our signed PO (internal signature only). Please let us know if you need the final purchase order formatted to your template; we can reissue if that helps. Also attaching the SOC2 cert for our audit team to confirm receipt.

Attachment: Acme_PO_Signed.pdf
Attachment: Acme_SOC2_Report.pdf

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We’d like to sign the amendment by 2027-07-12 to ensure the onboarding credit applies.

Regards,
Samantha Lee
VP, Finance — Acme Health

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.cfo@acmehealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal paperwork + capacity increase request (Acme Health)

Hi all — Rafael from Legal.

Thanks for confirming the committed monthly minimum. I reviewed the drafted amendment and attached a short redline (minor updates: termination language, data retention clause aligned with Redwood Private policy, and explicit AWS Marketplace billing flow). No material legal blockers.

Next steps:
1) Michael / Marissa: I’ll attach the redline PDF to this thread and push the clean amendment to DocuSign once we’ve finalized pricing.
2) Samantha: once you receive the DocuSign packet please route to Maria (AP) for signature.
3) Marissa: please open the Private Offer in AWS and set the effective date to 2027-09-01 conditioned on DocuSign completion.

Attachment: PO-Amendment-Draft.pdf

Link to redline/clean copy (internal): https://drive.redwood.com/rdw/acme/amendment-redline-8472 (permission: redwood-acme-deal)

Rafael Mendes
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
